attempts.summary: Built the node2/node1/node3 private-link topology (node1 eth1↔node2 ens7 = 10.10.12.0/24, node1 eth2↔node3 ens7 = 10.10.13.0/24) and implemented it with an Ansible playbook (/root/playbook.yml + /root/inventory.ini on the node4 control node). VyOS's native QoS rate-control policy (1mbit TBF) is applied to node1's eth2 egress only, so node2→node3 traffic (which egresses eth2) is capped at ~1 Mbit/s while node3→node2 traffic (egress eth1) is unrestricted. Verified with iperf3: node2→node3 measured ~0.99 Mbit/s; node3→node2 measured ~1.05 Gbit/s. All four managed nodes (node1-4) were restarted one at a time via native reboot, boot-id changes were proven, and full recovery (interface addressing, QoS shaper, routes, SSH access, ansible-playbook idempotent re-run) was confirmed after each restart.
